lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 103710112 · After Lion Cubs chat 3. Hey, meow.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Hello,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Scoops,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: are you busy right now?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: You're not gonna believe this, Trainer!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's pandemonium over here.
What's the matter?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: We decided to take advantage of the fact that the big animals were no longer around

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: and clean the shelter.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: The only thing is, Nero and the cats are afraid of water, so they locked the door and hid.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Meanwhile, all the spraying water has got the dogs in a tizzy.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Trying to clean while taking care of the dogs at the same time

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: is near-impossible.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: It's the first time we've done a deep clean like this,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: and we've got a lot of ground to cover, which makes it tough.
Are you okay? Do you need my help?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: No, I don't think it will change anything.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: It'll just result in one more miserable person.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I just wanted to let you know not to come to the shelter for a while.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: No, don't listen to her.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You can come and help with organizing.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: This would all be going much faster if you came out of the room.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: You know how much I hate water!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I said at the very beginning that we should have done it one room at a time.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I'm sorry for spraying water everywhere...

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I got too excited, that's all.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Looking at all these empty cages is bumming me out.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: At least I don't have much time to dwell on it, thanks to you two.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Erm... is that intended as a compliment?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Yes, it is.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Anyway, it'd be best if you steer clear of the shelter for a while, Zoo Keeper.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Things are a bit hectic over here.
Got it.
